product_description: Tandem is a fictional team note-taking app.

strategic_themes.name: enterprise readiness
strategic_themes.why: This year's top bet: unlock sales to larger teams.

strategic_themes.name: AI-assisted writing
strategic_themes.why: Differentiate the editor against generic note apps.

strategic_themes.name: mobile
strategic_themes.why: Keep mobile usable; not a growth bet this year.

features.name: Home-screen widget
features.description: A phone home-screen widget showing today's shared notes and a quick-capture button.
customer_quotes: Handy, I'd glance at it every morning.
Nice touch, but it wouldn't change how my team works.

features.name: SSO and audit log
features.description: SAML single sign-on plus an admin audit trail of who viewed and edited each note.
customer_quotes: Our security team blocked the Tandem rollout until there's SSO.
No audit log means procurement won't sign.

features.name: Offline conflict fix
features.description: Stop notes edited offline on two devices from silently overwriting each other.
customer_quotes: I lost an entire board meeting's notes. Twice. I nearly quit over it.
I don't trust Tandem on a plane any more, so I take notes on paper.

features.name: Smart paste cleanup
features.description: Strip stray formatting when pasting from email or web pages into a note.
customer_quotes: Mildly annoying to fix pasted text, but I live with it.
Would save me a few clicks a day.

features.name: AI thread summary
features.description: One-click summary of a long comment thread on a note, with open questions highlighted.
customer_quotes: If it's accurate, this would save my Monday mornings.
I've been burned by AI summaries that missed the key decision.

features.name: Admin usage dashboard
features.description: A dashboard for workspace admins showing active users and storage per team.
customer_quotes: I report seat usage to finance every quarter by hand.
